artifacts.title: Overture defining roles of unordained deaconesses and deacon assistants

matches.evidence: CCB found Grace Presbytery's overture on deaconesses and women officers in conflict with the Constitution, noting the session, not the congregation, is the appointing body requiring vows.

artifacts.title: Adding male-only ordination language as fundamental to system of doctrine

matches.evidence: The overture was in conflict because designating male-only ordination an 'essential component' of ecclesiology improperly added it to the 'fundamental to our system of doctrine' standard.
